description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/livingroom_1/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/livingroom_1/questions.pdf; its answer (8) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or a room-region restriction; hard = two chained relations.
Q01 and Q02 are deliberately paired: the dining set has eight chairs but the scene contains nine, so a model that ignores the vase anchor gets Q01 wrong.

Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Air vents, candle holders, small decorations and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
The iref color labels for this scene's pillows disagree with the rendered colors (the throw pillows read pink, teal and green), so no question in this scene filters on color.
'Potted plant' is avoided as a count target: six are labelled but several are tabletop succulents that a human would not count alongside the floor planters.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many chairs are near the table with a vase on it?
questions.evidence: Vase 71 (with orchids) stands on dining table 84; eight chairs (8, 54, 61, 64, 74, 81, 90, 98) surround it within 1.3 m. The living-room armchair 22 is 8.4 m away.

questions.question: How many chairs are in the scene in total?
questions.evidence: Eight dining chairs plus the black leather armchair (22) in the living area.

questions.question: How many windows are in the living room?
questions.evidence: Two windows in the brick wall behind the sofa (9, 39).

questions.question: How many ceiling lamps are hanging in the scene?
questions.evidence: Two drum pendants over the living area (35, 75) and two over the dining table (12, 94).

questions.question: How many curtains are next to the windows?
questions.evidence: One roller blind above each window (17, 45).

questions.question: How many pictures are hanging above the sofa?
questions.evidence: Four framed flower prints (50, 69, 83, 87) hang on the brick wall directly above sofa 0; the other three pictures are on different walls.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the sofa?
questions.evidence: Three throw pillows (16, 34, 41) sit on sofa 0.

questions.question: How many round tables are in front of the sofa?
questions.evidence: A white and a wooden round coffee table (60, 102) stand on the carpet in front of sofa 0.

questions.question: How many deck chairs are on the balcony?
questions.evidence: Two loungers (1, 19) are outside on the balcony (iref region 1), not in the room.

questions.question: How many dishes are on the table with the vase on it?
questions.evidence: Dining table 84 carries vase 71; the stack of plates on it consists of dishes 92 and 95.
